rules.statement: It was an implied term of the Agreement that the vendors should notify the purchasers when they had acquired full title, and that the period of one month must be reckoned only from the date of such notice.
rules.supporting_quote: I hold that it was an implied term of the Agreement that the vendors should notify the purchasers when they had acquired full title, and that the period of one month must be reckoned only from the date of such notice.

meta.parties: Jayasinghe and Others v. Jothiwardana and Others
